[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
Isabella Glasgow is named as the mother in the Minmi, New South Wales birth registrations of John (1882), David (1887), Annie (1889), Mary (1892) and Catherine (1894). The 1885 registration of Isabella Glasgow names the same parents.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/2568703 Ancestry, Australia, Birth Index, 1788–1922: John Glasgow, record 1778/2568703].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/2568251 Ancestry, Australia, Birth Index, 1788–1922: David Glasgow, record 1778/2568251].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/3247836 Ancestry, Australia, Birth Index, 1788–1922: Annie Glasgow, record 1778/3247836].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/3248486 Ancestry, Australia, Birth Index, 1788–1922: Mary Glasgow, record 1778/3248486].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/3247839 Ancestry, Australia, Birth Index, 1788–1922: Catherine Glasgow, record 1778/3247839].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The five birth registrations name Isabella Glasgow and Isabella Glasgow as the parents of the Minmi children. The records give no age, marriage, occupation or death for Isabella Glasgow. One registration calls the father John F Glasgow and one calls the mother Isabella Hamilton Glasgow; those variants may be a middle name or an indexing form and are not treated as proved additional names. The parent links to the children are probable from the repeated names, district and chronology, not proved by a single record beyond the births themselves.
